confidence_notes: I made two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Takayama food and drink prices. The RBA rate used is the confirmed 4pm figure for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). A 19 Nov figure of 0.6677 appeared in search results but I could not confirm it. Takayama-specific drink prices were thin. Beer was estimated from about ¥700 at an izakaya (nationwide guide) and a travel-site range of €4–6. Cappuccino is a guess from a ¥300–600 coffee benchmark. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, with a cocktail guide figure of about $10 and a national wine estimate of ¥1,000 or more. Meal prices are supported by the ¥3,000–5,000 izakaya dinner range and a ¥2,000–5,000 yakiniku range per person. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings inspected. Takayama is a high-demand tourist town, so summer rates can be much higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Japanese regional tourist towns such as Kanazawa or Matsumoto, with nationwide Japan price benchmarks and Takayama travel-guide prices.
